Name: TALK_PARAM_ST
Description: Lines of NPC dialogue and cutscene subtitles: text, voice, lip-sync and timing per line. A conversation started at a row plays the following row IDs in turn (ID, ID+1, ID+2, ...) and ends at the first missing ID. Text and voice follow the player's body type.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.
Padding.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Message ID - Body Type A
Fields.Description: Subtitle text (TalkMsg) of the line when the player is Body Type A.

Fields.Name: Voice ID - Body Type A
Fields.Description: Voice played for the line when the player is Body Type A: the sound event Play_v followed by the 9-digit ID. -1: no voice.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID [0]
Fields.Description: Has no working effect: the game reads the SpEffect/motion pairs at older positions, so this value is taken as the motion of a pair keyed on Voice ID - Body Type A. -1 in retail; leave at -1.

Fields.Name: Motion ID [0]
Fields.Description: Has no working effect: the game reads the SpEffect/motion pairs at older positions, so this value is taken as the SpEffect that triggers the motion in SpEffect ID [1]. -1 in retail; leave at -1.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID [1]
Fields.Description: Has no working effect: the game reads the SpEffect/motion pairs at older positions, so this value is taken as the motion played when the speaker has the SpEffect in Motion ID [0]. -1 in retail; leave at -1.

Fields.Name: Motion ID [1]
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. -1 in retail.

Fields.Name: Redirect Talk ID
Fields.Description: Talk ID played instead of this line when Redirect Event Flag ID is on; the redirect is checked again on that row. Retail: 0 everywhere, with no redirect flag set.

Fields.Name: Reaction ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. -1 in retail.

Fields.Name: Redirect Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag checked when a conversation starts at this row: when it is on, the conversation starts from Redirect Talk ID instead. -1: none (every retail row).

Fields.Name: Message ID - Body Type B
Fields.Description: Subtitle text (TalkMsg) of the line when the player is Body Type B.

Fields.Name: Voice ID - Body Type B
Fields.Description: Voice played for the line when the player is Body Type B: the sound event Play_v followed by the 9-digit ID. -1: no voice.

Fields.Name: Lip Sync Start
Fields.Description: Seconds after the line starts before the speaker's lip-sync begins. -1: no lip-sync.

Fields.Name: Lip Sync Time
Fields.Description: Seconds the speaker's lip-sync lasts. -1: until the line ends.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Voice Timeout
Fields.Description: Seconds before the line moves on if its voice hasn't finished. -1 uses NPC Talk Timeout Threshold (GameSystemCommonParam). A longer time given by the talk script wins.

Fields.Name: Talk Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation the speaker plays during this line; passed to the speaker's behaviour script while it is the current speaker. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Force Subtitle Display
Fields.Description: Marks the line's subtitle as forced, for talk and cutscene subtitles. Likely shows it even with subtitles turned off (the options check wasn't traced).
Padding.
Padding.
